def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import glob
    paths = sorted(glob.glob('data/astronomy/input/STORM-AI/warmup/v2/Sat_Density/swarma-*2015*.csv'))
    dfs = []
    for p in paths:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df['__source_file'] = p.split('/')[-1]
        dfs.append(df)
    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True) if dfs else pd.DataFrame()
    return out

def process(initial_states):
    import pandas as pd
    df = initial_states.copy()
    # ensure datetime
    df['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Timestamp'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Timestamp'])

    df = df[df['Timestamp'].dt.year == 2015]
    # enforce midnight
    df = df[df['Timestamp'].dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S') == '00:00:00']

    # altitude filter
    df['Altitude (km)'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Altitude (km)'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Altitude (km)'])
    df = df[(df['Altitude (km)'] >= 450) & (df['Altitude (km)'] <= 500)]

    return df[['File ID', 'Timestamp', 'Altitude (km)']].sort_values('Timestamp').reset_index(drop=True)

operators.customDisplayName: Filter initial_states to year 2015 and midnight (00:00:00) and altitude 450–500 km; coerce Timestamp to datetime and Altitude to numeric; return File ID, Timestamp, Altitude

def process(initial_2015_midnight, swarma_2015):
    import pandas as pd

    # Ensure comparable timestamps (both are already datetime per stats, but normalize to naive UTC)
    init = initial_2015_midnight.copy()
    dens = swarma_2015.copy()

    init['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(init['Timestamp'], utc=True).dt.tz_convert(None)
    dens['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(dens['Timestamp'], utc=True).dt.tz_convert(None)

    # Keep only 2015 density timestamps at exactly 00:00
    dens = dens[(dens['Timestamp'].dt.year == 2015) & (dens['Timestamp'].dt.hour == 0) & (dens['Timestamp'].dt.minute == 0) & (dens['Timestamp'].dt.second == 0)]

    # Clean density: drop NaNs and sentinel 9.99E32
    col = 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'
    dens[col] = pd.to_numeric(dens[col], errors='coerce')
    dens = dens.dropna(subset=[col])
    dens = dens[dens[col] != 9.99e32]

    # Join on timestamp (initial states already filtered to 2015 midnight and 450-500 km)
    merged = init.merge(dens[['Timestamp', col]], on='Timestamp', how='inner')

    return merged

operators.customDisplayName: Join 2015 initial state midnights (alt 450–500 km) to Swarm Alpha 2015 density at exactly 00:00 by Timestamp; clean density by dropping NaNs and sentinel 9.99E32; output matched rows with density

def process(density_at_initial_midnights):
    import numpy as np
    df = density_at_initial_midnights.copy()
    # Deduplicate in case join produced duplicates (e.g., duplicate timestamps in swarma files)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Timestamp'])
    avg = df['Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'].astype(float).mean()
    return df.iloc[:0].assign(avg_density=[avg])

operators.customDisplayName: Deduplicate matched midnight rows by Timestamp and compute mean Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3); output single-row table with avg_density
